mentions.name: Erlang-Red
mentions.description: A Node-RED-style flow editor backed by an Erlang runtime, aiming to implement visual flow-based programming for Erlang.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working Erlang-Red[1] which is Node-RED flow editor with an Erlang backend.

Basically the aim is to implement visual flow based programming for Erlang.

mentions.name: Erlang-RED
mentions.description: This is a visual low-code programming environment for Erlang, combining Node-RED with Erlang and based on flow-based programming principles. It supports creating HTTP endpoints and routing traffic between pathways based on path variables, making it possible to build applications such as a blog.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Erlang-RED[2] a combination of Node-RED[1] and Erlang to create a visual low code programming environment for Erlang based on the principles of flow based programming.

Reached a milestone today by being able to create a http endpoint and route the traffic (based to path variables) between various pathways. Thus it is possible to create a blog using Erlang-RED - what all good frameworks should be able to do ;)
